Question ID: BIO_U01_PRETEST_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.BIO.SCI.01

Seedling observation

Seedling A is 8.2 cm tall after 7 days; Seedling B is 5.1 cm.

Pretest — What Counts as Biology Evidence?, Seedling observation: Which statement shows the strongest readiness to interpret this Unit 1 evidence?

answer.text: A is taller under the recorded conditions, but height alone does not prove it is healthier.

feedback.text: Correct. A is taller under the recorded conditions, but height alone does not prove it is healthier. This conclusion follows from the displayed evidence: Seedling A is 8.2 cm tall after 7 days; Seedling B is 5.1 cm.

answer.text: Light duration is the independent variable and mean height is the dependent variable.

feedback.text: This option describes a different biological relationship: “Light duration is the independent variable and mean height is the dependent variable.” The displayed label, value, or relationship does not support that interpretation.

answer.text: The count is an observation; calling them a new species would require more evidence.

feedback.text: This option describes a different biological relationship: “The count is an observation; calling them a new species would require more evidence.” The displayed label, value, or relationship does not support that interpretation.

answer.text: The topic name alone is sufficient; the displayed evidence does not need to be interpreted.
